top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, decades-replicated discovery arc: Holst on incretin and GLP-1 physiology, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology, Mojsov on identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, confirmed in large independent randomized trials in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The citation is scoped to physiology and active peptide forms, not to specific drugs. The Mojsov versus Habener-group priority question is a real but unresolved attribution risk, not evidence the discovery is doubtful, so I rank an award above no award.
